preamble.summary: Isaiah 14 closes the Babylon-oracle and contains the famous 'HOW YOU ARE FALLEN, O DAY STAR, SON OF DAWN' passage (vv. 12–15) — read in Christian-tradition (after Jerome's Vulgate-rendering 'Lucifer') as describing-the-fall-of-Satan. Jesus' 'I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven' (Luke 10:18) Christologically-extends this-passage.
preamble.notable_variants: 14:12 'how you are fallen, O Day Star' → Vulgate 'LUCIFER' tradition; Christological-application via Luke 10:18; 14:13–14 'I will ascend to heaven … I will be like the Most High' the FIVE-FOLD-I-WILLS of pride; 14:25 'break Assyria in my land.'

variant_notes: 'For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob and will again choose Israel, and will set them in their own land, and sojourners will join them and will attach themselves to the house of Jacob' tracks MT. SOJOURNERS-JOIN — Gentile-inclusion theology. Romans 11:17–24's olive-tree-grafting parallels.

'And the peoples will take them and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will possess them in the LORD's land as male and female slaves. They will take captive those who were their captors, and rule over those who oppressed them' tracks MT.

'When the LORD has given you rest from your pain and turmoil and the hard service with which you were made to serve' tracks MT. REST-FROM-PAIN. Hebrews 4:9–11's 'Sabbath rest' Christologically-extends.

'You will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased, the insolent fury ceased!' tracks MT. TAUNT-SONG against-Babylon-king. Revelation 18 (Babylon-fallen taunts) extends.
'The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of rulers' tracks MT.
'That struck the peoples in wrath with unceasing blows, that ruled the nations in anger with unrelenting persecution' tracks MT.
'The whole earth is at rest and quiet; they break forth into singing' tracks MT. WHOLE-EARTH-AT-REST — post-tyrant-cosmic-relief.
'The cypresses rejoice at you, the cedars of Lebanon, saying: Since you were laid low, no woodcutter comes up against us' tracks MT.

'Sheol beneath is stirred up to meet you when you come; it rouses the shades to greet you, all who were leaders of the earth; it raises from their thrones all who were kings of the nations' tracks MT. SHEOL-WELCOMES-BABYLON — underworld-greeting committee.
'All of them will answer and say to you: You too have become as weak as we! You have become like us!' tracks MT.
'Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, the sound of your harps; maggots are laid as a bed beneath you, and worms are your covers' tracks MT. WORMS-AS-BED — death's-equalization.

verses.mt_reading: אֵיךְ נָפַלְתָּ מִשָּׁמַיִם הֵילֵל בֶּן־שָׁחַר נִגְדַּעְתָּ לָאָרֶץ חוֹלֵשׁ עַל־גּוֹיִם
verses.lxx_reading: πῶς ἐξέπεσεν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὁ ἑωσφόρος ὁ πρωὶ ἀνατέλλων συνετρίβη εἰς τὴν γῆν ὁ ἀποστέλλων πρὸς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη
verses.mt_rendering: How you are fallen from heaven, O Day Star, son of Dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, you who laid the nations low!
verses.variant_rendering: How has Lucifer, the morning star, fallen from heaven! He who sent rulers to all the nations is shattered to the ground
variant_notes: LUCIFER TRADITION. The Hebrew helel ben-shachar ('shining-one, son-of-dawn') refers to-the-morning-star (Venus). The LXX renders heōsphoros ('dawn-bringer / morning-star'). Jerome's Vulgate (4th-century Latin) translates LUCIFER ('light-bearer') — and from Jerome's-text, the term-Lucifer became-the-Christian-name-for-Satan, although-the-text's-immediate-referent is-the-Babylonian-king.

CHRISTOLOGICAL-APPLICATION VIA LUKE 10:18. Jesus' 'I saw Satan FALL LIKE LIGHTNING from heaven' (etheōroun ton Satanan hōs astrapēn ek tou ouranou pesonta) is-traditionally-read-as-applying this-Isaiah-passage to-Satan's-original-fall. Revelation 9:1, 12:8–9 ('the great dragon was thrown down, that ancient serpent') extend.

MORNING-STAR REVERSAL. Christologically — the original-morning-star Lucifer-fell, but Christ-as-the-true-morning-star ascends. 2 Peter 1:19 ('the MORNING STAR rises in your hearts,' phōsphoros) and Revelation 22:16 ('I am … the bright morning star') reclaim-the-morning-star image-for-Christ.

'You said in your heart: I will ascend to heaven; above the stars of God I will set my throne on high; I will sit on the mount of assembly in the far reaches of the north' tracks MT. FIRST AND SECOND I-WILL of pride. The five-fold-I-WILLS (vv. 13–14) catalog-of-arrogance.

'I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High' tracks MT. THIRD, FOURTH, FIFTH I-WILL — climax: I-WILL-MAKE-MYSELF-LIKE-THE-MOST-HIGH. The original-sin of-pride. The Christological-contrast: Phil 2:6–7 ('though he was in the form of God, did not count equality with God a thing to be grasped, but emptied himself') — Christ-takes-opposite-trajectory.
'But you are brought down to Sheol, to the far reaches of the pit' tracks MT. BROUGHT-DOWN-TO-SHEOL — the divine-counter to-the-five-I-WILLS.
'Those who see you will stare at you and ponder over you: Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who shook kingdoms?' tracks MT.
'Who made the world like a desert and overthrew its cities, who did not let his prisoners go home?' tracks MT.
'All the kings of the nations lie in glory, each in his own tomb' tracks MT.

'But you are cast out, away from your grave, like a loathed branch, clothed with the slain, those pierced by the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit, like a dead body trampled underfoot' tracks MT.
'You will not be joined with them in burial, because you have destroyed your land, you have slain your people. May the offspring of evildoers nevermore be named!' tracks MT.
'Prepare slaughter for his sons because of the guilt of their fathers, lest they rise and possess the earth, and fill the face of the world with cities' tracks MT.
'I will rise up against them, declares the LORD of hosts, and will cut off from Babylon name and remnant, descendants and posterity, declares the LORD' tracks MT.
'And I will make it a possession of the hedgehog, and pools of water, and I will sweep it with the broom of destruction, declares the LORD of hosts' tracks MT. BROOM-OF-DESTRUCTION imagery.

'The LORD of hosts has sworn: As I have planned, so shall it be, and as I have purposed, so shall it stand' tracks MT. AS-I-HAVE-PLANNED-SO-IT-SHALL-BE — divine-decree formula. Eph 1:11 ('the counsel of his will') extends.

'That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and on my mountains trample him underfoot; and his yoke shall depart from them, and his burden from their shoulder' tracks MT. BREAK-ASSYRIAN-IN-MY-LAND — fulfilled in 701 BCE Sennacherib's-defeat (2 Kings 19:35).
'This is the purpose that is purposed concerning the whole earth, and this is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations' tracks MT.
'For the LORD of hosts has purposed, and who will annul it? His hand is stretched out, and who will turn it back?' tracks MT.
'In the year that King Ahaz died came this oracle' tracks MT. AHAZ-DIED — c. 715 BCE.

'Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of you, that the rod that struck you is broken, for from the serpent's root will come forth an adder, and its fruit will be a flying fiery serpent' tracks MT. PHILISTIA-ORACLE.
'And the firstborn of the poor will graze, and the needy lie down in safety; but I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant it will slay' tracks MT.
'Wail, O gate; cry out, O city; melt in fear, O Philistia, all of you! For smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks' tracks MT.

'What will one answer the messengers of the nation? The LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people find refuge' tracks MT. AFFLICTED-IN-ZION-FIND-REFUGE. Hebrews 12:22 ('you have come to Mount Zion … the heavenly Jerusalem') Christologically-extends.
